evidence.detail: The single public resolver matches dozens of exact presentation names including Donator/PvP/Exotic mystery boxes, Blood/Grand blood keys, bond caskets/keys, event caskets and seasonal packages.
Each recognized name selects a hardcoded int[] of representative item-definition ids and may normalize/augment the tooltip label before presentation.

For a recognized container the resolver calls Client.a(int,int,String,int[]); that Client method constructs R207 TooltipContent, attaches the int[] through TooltipContent.a(int[]), then submits it to R207 TooltipOverlay.

The method returns only handled/not-handled and never performs RNG, quantity selection, inventory mutation or server action. The item arrays are therefore client tooltip preview content, not authoritative reward tables.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 presentation name. Hardcoded preview item IDs must not be treated as authoritative reward probabilities or server loot definitions.
